brief: A courtyard in Pāṭaliputra at dusk: two scholars facing each other, one older and assured, one thin and pale; a ring of silent listeners; above, a dark sky with a great shape of cloud and the faint outline of an ascetic with a crescent moon raising a hand; an unrolled palm-leaf manuscript on the ground between the two debaters.
